description: This PHP class defines a Drupal migration source plugin for extracting Drupal 6 field instance data from the database, including query construction, field definitions, row preparation, and ID specification.

classes.name: Drupal\field\Plugin\migrate\source\d6\FieldInstance
classes.description: Defines a Drupal 6 field instance source plugin for migration, including query building, field definitions, row preparation, and ID retrieval.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds and returns the database query to retrieve field instance data, optionally filtered by node type.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Returns an array of field definitions with labels for the source data.

methods.name: prepareRow
methods.description: Prepares each source row by unserializing certain fields and determining translatability based on synchronization settings.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Returns the primary key definitions for the source data.
